description:
List the test faxes that Faxbeep received and published, newest first. The list is public and holds the tests of everyone. Each item of "faxes" is a fax object: slug, source ("phone" or "email"), from (the sender, masked as on faxbeep.com, or null), received_at, page_count, file_size, pdf_url, thumbnail_url and view_url (the page of the fax on faxbeep.com). In the result, "since" is the start time that was used, and "now" is the server time.

The result holds at most "limit" faxes (20 when not given), newest first, with no paging. When "faxes" has "limit" items, there can be more: narrow the list with from, page_count or a since closer to the test.

Set "since" to the "now" value that get_test_numbers or list_test_faxes returned just before the person sent the test, and keep it fixed while you poll. Do not use your own clock. Do not move since to the newest received_at: a long fax can appear after a newer, shorter one. Without "since", the list covers the last 24 hours.

A match by time, sender or page count narrows the candidates. It does not prove that a fax is the person's, because other people send tests at the same time. Show the person the view_url so they can check the page. In a chat that shows images, also show thumbnail_url as an image in your answer.

An empty list is a normal answer while a fax is on its way. A new fax usually appears within a minute after the call ends or the email is sent; a few take longer. Wait about 30 seconds between calls, and stop after about 10 minutes. A fax is public for 30 days, then it is removed.

For a sample answer, set from to FAXBEEP-EXAMPLE: the result is the sample fax fax_example, whatever since says. The sample has a fixed date in the past, older than 30 days, and it stays available.

from.description: Only faxes from this sender: the full fax number (for example +15555550123) or station ID of the sending machine, or the sender address of an email test. Not the masked value of a result. The whole value must match; case does not matter.

limit.description: The most faxes to return, from 1 to 100. Default: 20.

page_count.description: Only faxes with this number of pages.

since.description: Only faxes received after this time, in ISO 8601 with an offset. Use the "now" value of get_test_numbers or of a list_test_faxes result, taken just before the person sends the test, not your own clock. Default: 24 hours ago. A fax older than 30 days is not in the list.

name: list_test_faxes
title: List received test faxes
